summary: This dataset involves the study of central serous chorioretinopathy (CSC) and choroidal vasculature through a 4-year training program in statistical genetics. The study aims to identify common genetic variation associated with CSC and choroidal thickness, and investigate overlap with known genetic associations to age-related macular degeneration (AMD). The research involves a genome-wide association study (GWAS) meta-analysis of biobank data, choroidal thickness measurements on optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, and quantitative trait analyses to identify novel loci for CSC and choroidal thickness.
